description: Enigma 36: one project of 36 resources drawn by seed from every type flisk resource creates (each backend framework and language, each frontend framework, worker, mcp, agent with each durability, database, bring-your-own, sdk) over six stacks, checked on the diagonal board (plan.mjs) before one flisk up. Every resource must meet its type's contract beside the other 35, a seeded restart must come back without taking a neighbour down, and an undrawn name is one error envelope. Each night draws a new combination; the seed is printed, and E2E_SEED replays it.
